title: Banyan Tree Beach Residences Varuna
shortDescription: Eight four-bedroom beachfront townhomes on Bang Tao Beach inside Laguna Phuket, launched by Banyan Group Residences in July 2026.
description:
Banyan Tree Beach Residences Varuna is a collection of just eight beachfront townhomes on Bang Tao Beach, inside Laguna Phuket, launched by Banyan Group Residences in July 2026. According to the developer, it occupies one of the few remaining absolute beachfront sites within Laguna.
Each four-bedroom townhome spans four levels. The design, described as "Coastal Biophilia", combines curved building lines with slatted timber cladding and trellis screening, and floor-to-ceiling glazing opens onto the Andaman Sea. The main living and dining spaces sit on the upper level, a private lift serves every floor, and each home has a garden terrace at ground level and a west-facing rooftop infinity pool and terrace. The master suite has a floor of its own, with a walk-in closet, a reading room and an ensuite bathroom that opens to a private courtyard.
Owners receive Sanctuary Club membership, RAVA Beach Club and Laguna Golf membership, 24-hour concierge and one year of complimentary property management and insurance under the Laguna Advantage programme. The developer's launch release gives no price, size or completion date; listings quote very different prices, so ask us for the current price list.
